display.label: Azure RBAC
display.description: Azure Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) role assignments for granting access permissions to security principals across Azure scopes

resource.key_description: The unique key identifier for this Role Assignment entry (used as the map key in terraform.tfvars).

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core Role Assignment settings including scope, principal, and principal type.

fields.label: Role Assignment Identifier
fields.description: Unique key or UUID identifying this role assignment. If a valid UUID is provided, it is used as the Azure Role Assignment name; otherwise Azure/Terraform generates one automatically.

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: The target Azure scope at which the role assignment applies (e.g. Subscription, Resource Group, Management Group, or specific Resource ID).

fields.label: Principal ID (Object ID)
fields.description: The Azure AD / Entra ID Object ID of the User, Group, Service Principal, or Managed Identity receiving permissions.

validation.pattern_error: Principal ID must be a valid Azure Active Directory / Entra ID Object ID (GUID format).

fields.label: Principal Type
fields.description: The type of the principal. Explicitly specifying this prevents ABAC filter issues during role assignment.

sections.label: Role Definition
sections.description: Specify either a built-in role name or a custom role definition ID.

fields.label: Built-in Role Definition Name
fields.description: The name of a built-in Azure role (e.g. 'Reader', 'Contributor', 'Owner', 'Storage Blob Data Contributor', 'Key Vault Secrets User'). Mutually exclusive with Role Definition ID.

fields.label: Custom Role Definition ID
fields.description: The Scoped-ID of a custom Role Definition. Mutually exclusive with Role Definition Name.

sections.label: Advanced & ABAC Settings
sections.description: Optional configurations including descriptions, ABAC conditions, and Service Principal replication lag handling.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: A description explaining the purpose or rationale of this role assignment.
fields.placeholder: Allow read access to workload storage

fields.label: Skip Service Principal AAD Check
fields.description: If the Principal ID is a newly provisioned Service Principal, set to true to bypass the Azure Active Directory check which might otherwise fail due to replication lag.

fields.label: ABAC Condition
fields.description: The condition that limits the resources that the role can be assigned to (Azure Attribute-Based Access Control).

fields.label: Condition Version
fields.description: The version of the ABAC condition. Required if an ABAC condition is specified.

fields.label: Delegated Managed Identity Resource ID
fields.description: The delegated Azure Resource Id containing a Managed Identity (used in cross-tenant scenarios).
